label: auto-only baseline (no AI casts)
blocked_skillshot: chooseExecutionCast in sim/ai/brain.ts returns null unless champ is kerrig|huntress (gated R only; never Q/W). No skillshot isolation preset without sim edits.

random_draft.draft: quickDraftPicks(seed) — lab Mulberry32 hash stream, Fisher–Yates, deal 5+5
inventions: lab-local Mulberry32 stream mixed from seed⊕domain (not sim RNG stream `draft`)
Fisher–Yates then blue=first5 / red=next5 (no role-preference fill — that forced both tops+supports every game)
side_swap_pairs: each seed runs twice with blue/red picks swapped

isolation.justification: callFollowSlack(T)=1+0.01*max(0,50−T) is 1.0 for T≥50. Floor T=40 so +30 moves slack 1.10→1.00. Side-swapped pairs + mirror control target ~50% base WR (§8.5 / GD).
isolation.mastery: mastery_one on blue ADC pick only (§8.5) — not mastery_all

definitions.f1_teamfights: F1 (S5-R6-8): engagement = maximal run of cross-team hit/status_apply with gap ≤ 3.0 s; teamfight = engagement lasting ≥ 3.0 s with ≥ 3 distinct units per side (dealt or took damage). Count per game.
definitions.f2_combo_chains: F2 (S5-R6-8): hard-CC status_apply by A on enemy X, then within min(CC duration+0.5 s, 2.0 s) damage on X from ≥ 2 distinct units of A's team (A counts), ≥ 1 skill hit (skill_id ≠ auto).
definitions.f3_clutch_moments: F3 (S5-R6-8): (a) low-HP escape — hit to ≤ 15% max HP during a teamfight, alive 5.0 s later, once per unit per 5 s; plus (b) outnumbered win — at a teamfight's first death, the side with fewer living involved ends that fight with more takedowns.
definitions.f4_close_finish: F4 (S5-R6-8): close = 1 if final margin ≤ 2 or end_reason is sudden_death, else 0.
definitions.contested_pit_share: R6-5 pit contest proxy from the event log: share of fight_call events whose centroid is within ZONE_RADIUS of ZONE_CENTER. True “owned time that is contested” needs occupancy ticks (not exported); this is the lab stand-in.
definitions.f4_comeback: F4 companion: 1 if winner trailed by ≥ 3 at some score point.
definitions.f4_shutout: F4 companion: 1 if loser score is 0.
definitions.f4_multikills: F4 companion: count of double-kill windows (same killer ≥ 2 deaths within 6.0 s).
